## Claims
- [computed] The supplied JSON outputs are complete parseable objects, but task-35 omits explicit zero-pair lists; its counts and nonzero lists must be combined with the stipulated \(3^3\) box-pair domains to reconstruct those sets. [artifact 5f7eb5aa0d59e08aab90d3c02cf841a27757c565b9767b52f18b45541dd78853]
- [computed] Under the finite box-basis hypothesis with \(J\)-columns \((22,221,32,222,321,33,322,331,332,333)\), both records give \(18\) nonzero Pieri products, \(36\) nonzero LR products, Pieri rank \(7\), LR rank \(7\), and Smith nonzero invariants \((1,1,1,1,1,1,1)\). [artifact 5f7eb5aa0d59e08aab90d3c02cf841a27757c565b9767b52f18b45541dd78853]
- [computed] The F1 complement \((221,222,321,322,331,332,333)\) has a unimodular Pieri minor \(+1\), using rows \((22;h_1),(32;h_1),(221;h_1),(33;h_1),(222;h_1),(331;h_1),(332;h_1)\). All \(36\) listed nonzero LR rows have integral coordinates in this selected Pieri lattice. [artifact 5f7eb5aa0d59e08aab90d3c02cf841a27757c565b9767b52f18b45541dd78853]
- [computed] The independently enumerated record uses reversed column order \((333,332,331,33,322,321,32,222,221,22)\), with fresh order digest `4fab47d24e13fd7e9209cb247b40d10c0e296ac9d6bde5c48b5d023aa1f22bf4`, Pieri digest `62ee90803236708aad718c4d530d770b0e48fa2c70c2aa34524210645e3d3cce`, and LR digest `3744a3be7e086134ce38f189b2954a7d439e79998a97142c69dc83cdc0559191`. [artifact 5f7eb5aa0d59e08aab90d3c02cf841a27757c565b9767b52f18b45541dd78853]
- [unsupported] A semantic canonical digest agreeing across both schemas has not been supplied; the reported canonical JSON digests `671c93b02e33395aac1079af0392fdb879b2ea8f3be0411778b98a6f1b8bd571` and `789ba50b8895f6282f6791f9ef0e9cbf4723c5767fe010a5a31c533d65478355` are schema-dependent and unequal. [artifact 5598eb67bce9f870e45c19b0fe74a6a60bbd0eb4a519c4db1d78d916099e44f4]

## Strategy
Treat the result as a finite \(3^3\)-box computation, conditional on the stated Schur-basis and Pieri/LR presentation hypotheses. Reconstruct task-35 zero sets from its nonzero rows and counts, transport its vectors through the reversed column permutation, then compare the complete product maps and certify both complements by explicit unimodular minors and integral reductions.

## Gaps
- The supplied artifacts do not contain a cross-schema semantic canonical digest.
- F2’s explicit selected-row minor and integral containment reductions are not printed in the supplied artifacts.
- Critic and skeptic review remain pending.

## Next
